uncertainties: Expected executions per completed item and full expected material/base consumption have not been independently reproduced for this exact recipe. Expected total and ROI must stay unavailable.
Comparable listings are asking prices, not completed sales. Whole-build fit and in-game execution are not established.
Starting-base acquisition must use exactly item level 70. Higher item levels can change the affix pool and require a separate cost model.

steps.title: Roll life and recovery
steps.action: Use Deafening Essence of Greed on the acquired rare Shaper Pinnacle Tower Shield.
steps.continueWhen: 130+ explicit life, 4–5% life recovered on block and one open suffix.
steps.failureAction: Reject 3% recovery or full suffixes; pay another essence and reroll on the same base. No Scouring is needed for direct essence rerolls.

steps.title: Craft resistance
steps.action: Bench craft 29–35% Fire Resistance into the open suffix.
steps.continueWhen: 130+ explicit life, recovery at least 4%, crafted Fire Resistance at least 29%.
steps.failureAction: Reject a core with an incompatible existing fire-resistance modifier; return to paid Greed rerolls.
